what: What LOAD takes from a serving TP=2 pair's unified memory, on top of what the same pair rests at — the figure an `auto` KV pool must leave room for so that broker_parrot's 12 GB floor holds under load and not only at rest. The KV pool is pinned and allocated at start; full prefill chunks' activations and per-request state are not, and the caching allocator keeps what they grew. Every number is a measurement or a quoted log line.

boxes.note: box-a (head, box-a-host) and box-b (worker, box-b-host) are NVIDIA GB10: CPU and GPU share one 121.7 GiB LPDDR5X pool. vLLM itself reads 'free' on them as psutil's MemAvailable (vllm/utils/mem_utils.py MemorySnapshot.measure, is_integrated_gpu), the same number tp-rank's status reports.
